capstone.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Collaborative Reasoning & Execution Architecture
capstone.subtitle: Undergraduate Senior Engineering Capstone Project
capstone.institution: COMSATS University Islamabad — Department of Computer Science
capstone.description: An autonomous multi-agent orchestrator engineered to coordinate specialized LLM agents through deterministic tool-execution loops, verifiable state graphs, and low-latency context memory caches. Solves cyclic hallucination and ungrounded execution in production AI agents.
capstone.abstract: Traditional single-agent LLM systems struggle with complex multi-step reasoning, frequently stalling in recursive execution loops or hallucinating parameters. This capstone project develops an authoritative supervisor-worker agent mesh with deterministic verification gates, human-in-the-loop escalation switches, and structured telemetry.
